codeReview.summary: Fail. Commit 93160d9898be3dfa9efa36d12fc254011290b980 correctly creates the new server/profiles domain files, preserves the /api/profiles mount in server/index.ts, and updates the known imports in server/index.ts and server/automation/manual-actions.ts. However, the refactor does not fully preserve the previous API behavior: several profile endpoints lost their route-local 500 error handling and now fall through to the global Express error middleware instead.

issues.description: The new router only preserves explicit try/catch handling for some endpoints. GET /api/profiles/ (lines 37-40), POST /reconcile-runtime (139-141), POST /sync-status (144-150), POST /set-login-true (153-159), GET /assigned and /unassigned (162-173), and the three bulk list routes (176-206) now rely on the global middleware in server/index.ts:105-120 for unexpected failures. Before the refactor, each of those routes caught thrown errors and returned res.status(500).json({ error: message }) in server/api/profiles.ts:429-536. After this change, the same failures return the generic global error payload instead, so this pure refactor no longer preserves the existing /api/profiles error contract.
